llm.summary: The skill’s purpose is clear, but it asks users to install mutable external Python code for an app that stores sensitive elder-care, medication, allergy, and emergency-contact data.

dimensions.detail: Python and git are proportionate for this type of local companion agent, but the external unpinned implementation would run with the user’s local privileges while handling sensitive health, family, and emergency-contact data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is only SKILL.md and directs installation of the core implementation via unpinned pip packages, with a fallback clone of a mutable remote repository followed by editable install. That leaves the executable code outside the reviewed artifact and able to change after review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime behavior is mostly disclosed, including local memory writes, crisis memory, snapshots, and user-implemented notification. The user-facing instructions are almost entirely Chinese, which limits clarity for non-Chinese readers but does not by itself show malicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence to ~/.pasm-agents/<id>/ and unevictable emergency memories are disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should understand that personal and health-related facts may be saved locally across sessions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The elder companion purpose matches the documented capabilities: key-fact memory, medication reminders, crisis detection, local persistence, and returning escalation context. It clearly says it is not a medical device and does not itself place calls or send messages.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the upstream pasm-agents and pasm-skills code before installing, prefer a pinned version or reviewed commit, and run it in an isolated environment. Be especially careful because the tool is designed to persist medication, allergy, family, and emergency-contact information locally.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only documentation is a usability and disclosure limitation for some users, but it is consistent throughout the artifact and is not evidence of hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[T08] unexpected: The unpinned pasm-agents and pasm-skills installs are the main concern because the reviewed artifact does not bound which executable package versions users will run.
[T03] unexpected: The fallback git clone plus editable install retrieves executable code from a mutable remote branch without a reviewed commit or digest, so the effective runtime payload can differ from this review.
